scope: Part 1 only: equal-weight mean SSIM maximization, MILP versus GA
seed_rule: GA final trial seed = 10000 + scenario_index*1000 + repetition_index; both indices start at zero; 90 distinct seeds
rng: Python random.Random (Mersenne Twister), local instance per GA call
schedule: For each repetition, rotate scenario order by repetition modulo 3; within each scenario alternate MILP/GA order by (repetition+scenario_index) modulo 2. Sequential execution.
warmups: One excluded call per method per scenario; GA seeds 900000+scenario_index. No tuning or selection using warmup outcomes.
timing: perf_counter_ns immediately before the optimization function call until return; includes method-specific setup, feasibility check, population/model construction, solving/search, and result extraction; excludes imports, input reading, shared hash validation, output writing, independent result validation and all image work. MILP's internal solver-only time is also saved separately.

ga_details.encoding: 14 integer version indices in original image order; low=0, medium=1, high=2; only quality-eligible genes
ga_details.initialization: One minimum-byte feasible chromosome, ties by version order; 99 independently random eligible chromosomes, repaired if needed
ga_details.selection: Tournament of 3 sampled with replacement; highest equal-weight mean SSIM wins; exact score ties by lexicographically smaller chromosome
ga_details.crossover: Per mating pair probability 0.8; uniform independent 0.5 mask per gene; two complementary children
ga_details.mutation: Per gene probability 0.05; uniformly choose a different eligible version; singleton genes unchanged
ga_details.repair: At each step inspect all eligible strictly cheaper replacements, choose minimum (SSIM loss / bytes saved, image index, replacement version index); repeat until within budget. Allows zero or negative SSIM loss; never assumes monotonic bytes or SSIM.
ga_details.replacement: Copy best 2 chromosomes unchanged; produce 98 repaired offspring each generation; duplicates allowed; rank population on mean SSIM only, lexicographic chromosome tie-break
ga_details.stopping: Exactly 200 generations after initialization; no optimum-based early stop; no MILP solution/optimum provided to GA
ga_details.counts: Evaluate all 100 chromosomes at initialization and each generation: 20,100 fitness evaluations per full trial, including repeated chromosomes; preserve per-generation best score and distinct chromosome count

analysis: Report every trial, failures, feasibility rate, best/median/worst GA SSIM, absolute and relative-percent gap to proven MILP optimum, optimum-match frequency at absolute SSIM tolerance 1e-10, selected bytes, unused bytes, runtime median/Q1/Q3 with NumPy linear quantiles. Include first-call warmups separately. A match does not make GA an optimality-proving algorithm.
tests: Synthetic nonmonotonic repair, tie and singleton handling; infeasibility and units; deterministic seeded search; small exhaustive optimum comparison; independent checks of every final selection, quality floor, byte sum, objective, gap, status and preservation hashes
preservation: Reuse frozen existing candidates without regenerating, reencoding or changing scores/floors. Snapshot hashes before running; verify after. Original PDF remains unchanged.
report_corrections: Existing images were encoded using Pillow/libwebp, not the cwebp CLI
2.5 seconds is an assumed payload allowance, not measured page readiness
4,782,969 nominal choices; 1,062,882 after quality floors, before budget
Use new end-to-end optimization timings, not old solver-only times
